subject: West Medford Square Zoning Draft Proposal
overview: The committee held an initial review and discussion of a preliminary draft zoning proposal for West Medford Square. No votes were taken, and the committee will continue the discussion alongside Medford Square and accessory dwelling unit proposals on April 30.

items.title: Draft West Medford Square Zoning Proposal Presentation and Discussion
items.summary: Ines Associates presented a preliminary zoning draft that proposes replacing current commercial and residential districts with mixed-use and urban residential zones to allow increased density near the commuter rail stop.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Community members voiced general support for the density increases, while providing feedback on parking requirements, potential street congestion, and district boundaries.
